limits: Retrospective zero-target-label transfer evaluation across four exposure sites.
Effective q, Ceq, and Heq are source-calibrated empirical coordinates mapping meteorological histories into the laboratory domain.
Chinese site weather uses a representative one-year half-hourly series repeated over the four-year exposure window; KSC uses monthly forcing.
KSC: Ten-month marine atmospheric exposure series digitised from Montgomery et al. (NASA KSC-2012-049, 2012) with 7.85 g/cm3 mass-depth conversion.
prediction_unit: Corrosion current density in A/cm2 with Fe(II) Faraday conversion factor Gamma = 0.369 um/(A s cm-2).
